questions.why: Joe Simon and Jack Kirby created Cap for Timely Comics, years before Marvel's Silver Age.

questions.q: Which actor led the Marvel Cinematic Universe's Captain America trilogy?
questions.why: Chris Evans starred in the Captain America trilogy of the 2010s.

questions.q: Who is Captain America's primary archenemy, introduced as an apprentice to the Nazi leader?
questions.why: The Red Skull is Cap's main archenemy, introduced as Hitler's protege.

questions.q: Whom does Captain America punch on the cover of Captain America Comics #1?
questions.why: The first issue's cover shows Cap landing a punch on Hitler.

questions.q: Who invented the Super-Soldier Serum in the comics?
questions.why: Dr. Erskine devised the serum, and a Nazi spy killed him soon after its first success.

questions.q: Captain America first appeared in 1940-41 from which Marvel predecessor?
questions.why: Captain America Comics #1 came out from Timely Publications, a corporate predecessor of Marvel.

questions.q: Which Avengers issue, cover-dated March 1964, brought Steve Rogers back from the ice?
questions.why: Steve Rogers was formally reintroduced to the modern era in The Avengers #4 (March 1964).

questions.q: Sharon Carter was first introduced as the younger sister of which wartime love of Steve Rogers?
questions.why: Sharon was introduced as Peggy Carter's younger sister, later retconned into her grandniece.

questions.q: In which year did a Captain America serial become the first non-comics adaptation of a Marvel character?
questions.why: The 1944 serial was the first screen appearance of any Marvel Comics character outside comics.

questions.q: Which Avenger known as Falcon took over the Captain America mantle in 2014 comics?
questions.why: Sam Wilson, the Falcon, took up the shield and mantle in 2014 comics.
